text.p: Minerals explorer Jervois Mining NL said on Tuesday it had a lateritic nickel/cobalt prospect at Lake Innes, near Port Macquarie in New South Wales.
The company said 61 vertical air core drill holes had been completed to an average depth of about 25 metres.
Drilling results so far ranged from 0.64 percent nickel to 1.33 percent nickel while cobalt mineralisation showed a range of 0.03 percent cobalt to 0.22 percent cobalt.
The strongest result was from drill hole PM 37 which showed 1.33 percent Ni and 0.09 percent Co at a strike length of 12 metres at a depth of 23 metres.
At 12.30 p.m. (0230 GMT), Jervois shares were untraded but bid at 3.6 cents, up 0.001 on its previous close on September 2.
